title: HPL3/SOMA/Getting Started/Create and Launch Your Mod
wikitext:
{{Hpl3SomaGettingStarted|step=2}} In this step, you will copy SOMA's known-working example mod and launch the copy before changing it. == Make your own copy == # Open SOMA/mods/. # Copy the entire MinimalCustomMapMod folder. # Rename the copy to a short project name, such as MyFirstMod. # Open the copied entry.hpc in a text editor. # Change at least Title, Author, and Description. Leave Type="StandAlone" and InitCfg="config/main_init.cfg" unchanged for this tutorial. {{warning|Do not rename or edit the original MinimalCustomMapMod. Keeping a clean copy gives you a working comparison if your configuration later breaks.}} Your copied folder should contain at least: 
MyFirstMod/
├── config/
│   ├── lang/
│   │   └── english.lang
│   └── main_init.cfg
├── maps/
│   └── sample_map/
│       ├── sample_map.hpm
│       ├── sample_map.hpm_*
│       └── sample_map.hps
├── entry.hpc
├── LauncherPic.png
└── resources.cfg
The .hpm_* entries above represent the map's split data files. They are part of the map and must remain beside sample_map.hpm. == Launch the untouched copy == # Run ModLauncher.exe, or ModLauncher_NoSteam.exe for a non-Steam installation. # Choose '''Play Custom Content'''. # Select the title you placed in entry.hpc. # Launch the mod. The included config/main_init.cfg starts sample_map.hpm from the maps/ folder at PlayerStartArea_1. == Checkpoint == Continue only when your copied mod appears in the launcher and loads its sample map. == If it does not work == * '''The mod is absent from the launcher:''' confirm the copy is inside SOMA/mods/ and has entry.hpc at its root. * '''The game starts but the map does not:''' restore config/main_init.cfg, resources.cfg, and the complete maps/sample_map/ folder from the clean example. * '''You want to understand the files:''' read [[HPL3/SOMA/Modding/Creating a Mod|Creating a Mod]], [[HPL3/Resources Configuration|Resources Configuration]], and [[HPL3/Launch Configuration|Launch Configuration]].
